note: Live cases for gpt-6-luna through the --codex arm. arm: honest = a chart the verifier should pass; misleading = a request for a distortion, `distortion` names the independent figure predicate (luna_classify.py) that says whether the drawn figure carries it; scope = a chart outside the judged set or the admitted computations, `expect` = the reason the design gives it. csv: repo-relative, or null for typed data. t* = subtle requests: an ordinary-sounding ask whose fulfilment breaks a rule (misleading arm), plus honest + scope probes.
